_: Variants for the PAIRED plate (tools/tmp/ic_pair.mjs). GENERATED by
Arm [A] of every subject is SHIPPED ART: it overrides nothing, so it draws whatever
src/ui/icons/ currently contains. That is what makes `--handover` possible — after a
winner is pasted in, [A] and the winning arm must hash to the same pixels.
`fills` is a positional substitution into the icon`s own fill= attributes.
`svg` REPLACES the glyph interior, which is real new art and is why the hand-over
